test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: What has hindered the development of students?

options.text: expanding academics to the outside world

solution:
The correct answer is **'not gaining practical experience'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that in India, education has been traditionally confined to academics, without emphasis on practical experience.
 
• This limitation is highlighted as a hindrance to students’ development.
 
• The traditional misconception that practical experience is unnecessary has prevented students from obtaining skills needed in the real world.
 
• Practical experience is mentioned as essential for mental, social, and individual growth, which can't be achieved through academics alone.
 
• The shift in the 21st century towards including practical exposure in education is presented as a solution to this problem.
 
• The passage notes that practical activities such as guest lectures and industrial visits are being integrated into education to foster overall development.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Expanding academics to the outside world (Option 1) is a part of the new educational approach rather than a hindrance.
 
• Getting out into the field (Option 2) is actually mentioned as a necessary step for development, not a hindrance.
 
• Indulging in co-curricular activities (Option 4) supports overall growth and is encouraged, not a hindrance.
